card.name: Verbs right before fluid retention
card.fires_on: Small verbs like "cause", "be" or "is" after a drug name or "can/may", where the next words describe a drug effect such as fluid retention. Also "water" before "retention".

modes.description: The verb "cause" after "can" or "may" in a warning about fluid retention or other effects.

modes.description: The word "water" just before "retention" in a body-swelling description.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word "retention" (and explosive/bomb words), mainly fluid retention next.
card.plain: It fires on the verb just before a drug effect is named, especially when that effect is fluid retention.
